description: This file contains unit tests for the WindowPlacement utility, verifying window positioning calculations such as centering, aligning to top-right, and ensuring windows are on-screen.

classes.name: WindowPlacementTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing various test cases for window placement functions.

methods.name: `centered frame zero bounds falls back to origin`
methods.description: Tests that the centeredFrame function falls back to origin when given zero bounds.

methods.name: `centered frame clamps to bounds and centers`
methods.description: Tests that the centeredFrame function correctly clamps to bounds and centers the window.

methods.name: `top right frame zero bounds falls back to origin`
methods.description: Tests that the topRightFrame function falls back to origin when bounds are zero.

methods.name: `top right frame clamps to bounds and applies padding`
methods.description: Tests that topRightFrame clamps to bounds and respects padding.

methods.name: `ensure on screen uses fallback when window offscreen`
methods.description: Verifies that ensureOnScreen moves the window to a fallback position when it's offscreen.

methods.name: `ensure on screen does not move visible window`
methods.description: Verifies that ensureOnScreen does not move a window that is already visible on screen.
